directive.quote: Port the reader's logic line for line (rowsWith, one, the rents_a_host / points_a_name / public-door-placement shapes, the vault-name-only credentials). Replace only its source: file reads and writes become door records reads and writes.

old_copy.deleted_with: the same change that deletes the old door rows reader

targets.note: where the byte copy of the source landed at baseline.commit (a9ee2580, the one move of the remaining old trillion features); 2138b2f4 added the adapted file under do-work/ and 8d3d6cb5 removed this path

preserve: the DNS client allows only the exact-host zone, record, route and Worker-domain shapes, and only the mutations a cutover makes; anything else is refused before any network call
the token is sent only in the DNS row's auth header, and a provider refusal names its codes, never the token
prepare keeps the one address record or production Worker domain the hostname holds, and refuses when there is not exactly one
before every change, every other record, route and domain must be as prepare read them, else nothing is changed
a change whose answer was lost is reconciled from what the provider shows, never sent twice; each change is read back
rollback puts back exactly what prepare read, including a Worker custom domain
the receipt is saved before each provider change
allowed_deltas: the receipt is a row of the person's Public door receipts list (read-data/door-receipts.mjs), each save conditioned on the value last read, not a file renamed into place
the DNS provider row is always handed in, not defaulted to one named provider
the command-line entry that read the token from the old vault goes: tool:cut-a-hostname-over-to-a-new-address runs do-work/door-tools.mjs, which takes it from the row's credential mount
the receipt schema name loses its product prefix (after the byte copy at baseline.commit)
banned_substitutions: a change that ignores an unrelated record, route or domain that moved
the token in a receipt, an error or an answer

baseline.note: the copy commit first named here (1028d8fd5d, which held the copy with the schema-name prefix already dropped) is not in this repository's history; a9ee2580 holds the unredacted byte copy, and the prefix is dropped after it ('trillion.portable-dns-cutover/1' -> 'portable-dns-cutover/1')
